description: The Dissipate and Recentre project supplies structural tests on four two-storey glass-fibre-reinforced polymer frames at the Joint Research Centre’s European Laboratory for Structural Assessment. The specimens combine pultruded GFRP members, stainless-steel connections and concrete floor slabs, with braced and unbraced configurations. Snap-back, monotonic and cyclic tests recorded loads, displacements, rotations and strains. Zenodo distributes the data and metadata as a ZIP archive with CC BY 4.0 and the stated European Commission reuse terms. Access is free; the inspected metadata does not provide a full test calendar or inner file formats. The results can calibrate seismic structural simulations, but the tested configurations limit generalisation to other connections or buildings. No directly related catalogue entry was identified.
